180:     pub x_perm: PermissionU32,
181:     pub oneshot0_inv_half: OneShotResource,

183: }

187:     pub oneshot0_id: Loc,
188:     pub oneshot1_id: Loc,
189: }
190: 
191: pub struct CounterInvariantPredicate {}
192: 
193: impl InvariantPredicate<
194:     CounterInvariantConstants,
195:     CounterTrackedState,
196: > for CounterInvariantPredicate {
197:     open spec fn inv(c: CounterInvariantConstants, cts: CounterTrackedState) -> bool {
198:         &&& cts.x_perm@.patomic == c.x_id
199:         &&& cts.oneshot0_inv_half.id() == c.oneshot0_id
200:         &&& cts.oneshot1_inv_half.id()
201:             == c.oneshot1_id
202:         &&& cts.oneshot0_inv_half@ is HalfRightToComplete || cts.oneshot0_inv_half@ is Complete
203:         &&& cts.oneshot1_inv_half@ is HalfRightToComplete
204:             || cts.oneshot1_inv_half@ is Complete
205:         &&& cts.x_perm@.value == (if cts.oneshot0_inv_half@ is Complete {
206:             1int
207:         } else {
208:             0int
209:         }) + (if cts.oneshot1_inv_half@ is Complete {
210:             1int
211:         } else {
212:             0int
213:         })
214:     }
215: }
216: 
217: pub struct CounterSharedState {
218:     pub x: PAtomicU32,
219:     pub inv: Tracked<
220:         AtomicInvariant<CounterInvariantConstants, CounterTrackedState, CounterInvariantPredicate>,
221:     >,
222: }
223: 
224: impl CounterSharedState {
225:     pub open spec fn wf(self) -> bool {
226:         &&& self.x.id() == self.inv@.constant().x_id
227:         &&& self.inv@.namespace() == 888
228:     }
229: 
230:     pub open spec fn get_oneshot_id(self, which_thread: int) -> Loc
231:         recommends
232:             which_thread == 0 || which_thread == 1,
233:     {
234:         let c = self.inv@.constant();
235:         if which_thread == 0 {
236:             c.oneshot0_id
237:         } else {
238:             c.oneshot1_id
239:         }
240:     }
241: 
242:     pub fn new(
243:         Tracked(oneshot0_inv_half): Tracked<OneShotResource>,
244:         Tracked(oneshot1_inv_half): Tracked<OneShotResource>,
245:     ) -> (result: Arc<Self>)
246:         requires
247:             oneshot0_inv_half@ is HalfRightToComplete,
248:             oneshot1_inv_half@ is HalfRightToComplete,
249:         ensures
250:             result.wf(),
251:             result.get_oneshot_id(0) == oneshot0_inv_half.id(),
252:             result.get_oneshot_id(1) == oneshot1_inv_half.id(),
253:     {
254:         let (x, Tracked(x_perm)): (PAtomicU32, Tracked<PermissionU32>) = PAtomicU32::new(0);
255:         let tracked cts = CounterTrackedState { x_perm, oneshot0_inv_half, oneshot1_inv_half };
256:         let ghost c = CounterInvariantConstants {
257:             x_id: x.id(),
258:             oneshot0_id: oneshot0_inv_half.id(),
259:             oneshot1_id: oneshot1_inv_half.id(),
260:         };
261:         assert(CounterInvariantPredicate::inv(c, cts));  
262:         let inv = Tracked(AtomicInvariant::new(c, cts, 888));
263:         Arc::new(CounterSharedState { x, inv })
264:     }

266:     pub fn read_x(
267:         self: &Arc<Self>,
268:         Tracked(oneshot0_complete): Tracked<OneShotResource>,
269:         Tracked(oneshot1_complete): Tracked<OneShotResource>,
270:     ) -> (x: u32)
271:         requires
272:             self.wf(),
273:             oneshot0_complete.id() == self.get_oneshot_id(0),
274:             oneshot1_complete.id() == self.get_oneshot_id(1),
275:             oneshot0_complete@ is Complete,
276:             oneshot1_complete@ is Complete,
277:         ensures
278:             x == 2,
279:     {
280:         let x_value: u32;
281:         open_atomic_invariant!(self.inv.borrow() => inner => {
282:             proof {
283: 
284:                 inner.oneshot0_inv_half.lemma_is_complete_if_other_is(&oneshot0_complete);
285: 
286: 
287:                 inner.oneshot1_inv_half.lemma_is_complete_if_other_is(&oneshot1_complete);
288: 
289:             }
290:             x_value = self.x.load(Tracked(&inner.x_perm));
291:             assert(x_value == 2); 
292:         });
293:         x_value
294:     }
295: }
296: 
297: pub fn thread_routine(
298:     shared_state: Arc<CounterSharedState>,
299:     Tracked(oneshot_thread_half): Tracked<OneShotResource>,
300:     Ghost(which_thread): Ghost<int>,
301: ) -> (return_permission: Tracked<OneShotResource>)
302:     requires
303:         which_thread == 0 || which_thread == 1,
304:         oneshot_thread_half@ is HalfRightToComplete,
305:         shared_state.wf(),
306:         oneshot_thread_half.id() == shared_state.get_oneshot_id(which_thread),
307:     ensures
308:         return_permission@.id() == shared_state.get_oneshot_id(which_thread),
309:         return_permission@@ is Complete,
310: {
311:     let tracked mut oneshot_thread_half = oneshot_thread_half;
312:     open_atomic_invariant!(shared_state.inv.borrow() => inner => {
313:         shared_state.x.fetch_add_wrapping(Tracked(&mut inner.x_perm), 1);
314:         proof {
315:         }
316:     });
317:     Tracked(oneshot_thread_half)
318: }
319: 
320: pub fn count_to_two() -> (result: Result<u32, ()>)
321:     ensures
322:         result is Ok ==> result.unwrap() == 2,
323: {
324:     let tracked (mut oneshot0_inv_half, mut oneshot0_thread_half) =
325:         OneShotResource::alloc().split();
326:     let tracked (mut oneshot1_inv_half, mut oneshot1_thread_half) =
327:         OneShotResource::alloc().split();
328:     let shared_state = CounterSharedState::new(
329:         Tracked(oneshot0_inv_half),
330:         Tracked(oneshot1_inv_half),
331:     );
332:     let shared_state_clone = shared_state.clone();
333:     let join_handle0 = vstd::thread::spawn(
334:         move || -> (return_value: Tracked<OneShotResource>)
335:             ensures
336:                 return_value@.id() == shared_state.get_oneshot_id(0),
337:                 return_value@@ is Complete,
338:             { thread_routine(shared_state_clone, Tracked(oneshot0_thread_half), Ghost(0)) }
339:     );
340:     let shared_state_clone = shared_state.clone();
341:     let join_handle1 = vstd::thread::spawn(
342:         move || -> (return_value: Tracked<OneShotResource>)
343:             ensures
344:                 return_value@.id() == shared_state.get_oneshot_id(1),
345:                 return_value@@ is Complete,
346:             { thread_routine(shared_state_clone, Tracked(oneshot1_thread_half), Ghost(1)) }
347:     );
348:     if let (Ok(oneshot0_complete), Ok(oneshot1_complete)) = (
349:         join_handle0.join(),
350:         join_handle1.join(),
351:     ) {
352:         Ok(shared_state.read_x(oneshot0_complete, oneshot1_complete))
353:     } else {
354:         Err(())
355:     }
356: }
